name: Timbuctoo
source:
Main character has scary dreams since childhood. One day a person gets missing in his town. Protagonist knows that it relates to his dreams, but he still makes his way to the school to meet his fate.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
